_why: B-032. The linters verify artifacts, and artifacts are downstream of behaviour nobody measures. `B064` checks that voice.md RECORDS a humanization state; nothing checks that the sweep ran or that the status line was printed. These cases are the mechanism that can answer that, and they are deliberately not in CI: they cost money, they are not deterministic, and a flaky required check is one people learn to re-run until it passes.
_how: python3 test/evals/run.py [--case EV-NN]. Needs the `claude` CLI on PATH. Every case names the instruction it measures, and `validate_eval_cases` refuses a case whose anchor no longer resolves, so an instruction reworded here cannot leave its eval pointing at nothing.
